summary: Runtime dependency sourced from unpinned GitHub repository
details: package.json declares `libsignal` as a runtime dependency with the source `github:wanzchil/libsignal-node` — a git reference with no commit SHA, tag, or version pin. On `npm install`, this resolves to whatever the referenced repository's default branch currently serves, installs that code into node_modules, runs any lifecycle hooks inside it, and exposes it to the host package via `import * as libsignal from 'libsignal'` in lib/Signal/libsignal.js. The code executed on the installer is therefore whatever the owner of github.com/wanzchil/libsignal-node chooses to serve at install time, with no integrity check and no version boundary. The static match at lib/Utils/generics.js:403 is a weak keyword co-occurrence hit on a `ping` token and is not independently indicative of exfiltration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
